office: the Ministry of Interior's Agency for Civil Affairs

routes.label: by appointment booked on Absher at a civil affairs office: 14 days at most

note: From the Agency for Civil Affairs' own answers as the press reported them: the card is compulsory on turning 15 and optional from 6 (Ajel, 22 April 2024); it is valid ten years from issue, replacement or renewal and is renewed within the 180 days before expiry (Ajel, 23 October 2021); issuing it takes 14 days at most (Ajel, 24 August 2021); and reports of a fee for issuing it are untrue (Al-Iqtisad, 24 May 2018), so it is offered free. Late issue after 18, late renewal and a second loss carry fines of SAR 100 and more (not modelled), as does delivery of a card renewed online.
